entries.head: eat out

senses.en: to eat at a restaurant instead of at home

example.en: We eat out maybe twice a month — it adds up fast.
example.zh: 我们一个月大概下两次馆子，钱涨得很快。

entries.l1_note: “出去吃”不是 go out to eat 才地道；eat out 两个词就够，而且不带宾语。

entries.head: order in

senses.en: to have food delivered to your home

example.en: It's pouring — let's order in tonight.
example.zh: 下大雨了，今晚点外卖吧。

collocations: order in for the whole team
entries.l1_note: 点外卖送到家是 order in；takeout 是名词。

entries.head: pick at
entries.zh: 没胃口地戳着吃、挑着吃

senses.en: to eat only small amounts without much appetite

example.en: She only picked at her food and left half of it.
example.zh: 她只挑着吃了几口，剩了一半。

entries.l1_note: 没胃口地戳着吃是 pick at；pick 一个东西是挑。

entries.head: eat up

senses.en: to finish all the food

example.en: The kids ate up every last dumpling.
example.zh: 孩子们把饺子吃得一个不剩。

entries.l1_note: “吃完”不是 eat finished；eat up / finish 才自然。eats up 还有“消耗掉”的意思。

entries.head: whip up

senses.en: to make a meal quickly with what you have

example.en: I can whip up some fried rice in ten minutes.
example.zh: 我十分钟能炒个饭。

entries.l1_note: 快手做饭用 whip up，不是 cook fast 才自然。

entries.head: warm up

senses.en: to heat food that is already cooked

example.en: Just warm up the leftovers — I'm not cooking again.
example.zh: 把剩菜热一下就行，我不想再做一遍。

senses.en: to prepare your body for exercise

example.en: Warm up for five minutes before you start running.
example.zh: 跑步前先热身五分钟。

entries.l1_note: 加热是 heat up / warm up，不是 hot the food（中式）。

entries.head: cut down on

senses.en: to eat or use less of something

example.en: I'm trying to cut down on sugar this month.
example.zh: 我这个月想少吃点糖。

entries.l1_note: “减少”不是 reduce down（冗余）；cut down on 后面才跟对象。

entries.head: pig out

senses.en: to eat a lot in an uncontrolled way

example.en: We pigged out on hot pot and didn't move for an hour.
example.zh: 我们火锅吃到撑，一小时没动。

entries.l1_note: 暴吃是自嘲说法；pig out on 后面接食物。

entries.head: throw together

senses.zh: 用现有材料草草做一顿
senses.en: to make something quickly without much planning

example.en: I threw together a salad with whatever was in the fridge.
example.zh: 我用冰箱里有的东西随便拌了个沙拉。

entries.l1_note: 随便凑一顿；throw together 也有“匆忙拼凑”的意思。

entries.head: fill up on

senses.zh: 吃某样便宜或简单的东西填饱
senses.en: to eat enough of something to stop being hungry

example.en: Don't fill up on bread — the noodles are coming.
example.zh: 别用面包填饱了，面马上就来。

entries.l1_note: 靠某样东西填饱；别和 fill up（加油）混。

entries.head: eat in

senses.en: to eat at home instead of at a restaurant

example.en: Let's eat in tonight — the fridge is full.
example.zh: 今晚在家吃吧，冰箱塞满了。

entries.l1_note: eat in 是相对 eat out 的说法，不是“吃进去”。

example.en: We go out to eat on Fridays.
example.zh: 周五我们出去吃。

entries.head: box up

senses.en: to put leftover food into boxes

example.en: Can you box up the rest? We'll eat it tomorrow.
example.zh: 剩下的能打包吗？我们明天吃。

entries.l1_note: 打包是 box up / to go；doggy bag 是名词。

entries.head: split up

senses.en: to divide food or a bill among people

example.en: Let's split up the dumplings — I can't finish this.
example.zh: 饺子分着吃吧，我吃不完。

entries.l1_note: 分着吃/分摊是 split up；分手也是 split up。

entries.head: cut up

senses.en: to cut food into small pieces

example.en: Cut up the chicken for the kids first.
example.zh: 先给小孩把鸡肉切小块。

entries.l1_note: 切成小块是 cut up；切开一道口子是 cut open。

entries.head: chop up

senses.en: to cut something into small pieces with a knife

example.en: Chop up some garlic and ginger first.
example.zh: 先把蒜和姜剁碎。

entries.l1_note: chop up 是剁，cut up 是切块，程度不同。

entries.head: serve up

senses.en: to put food on the table for people

example.en: She served up a huge pot of noodles.
example.zh: 她端上来一大锅面。

entries.l1_note: serve up 是端上；serve 单独是服务。

entries.head: dish out

senses.en: to give food to each person

example.en: Dish out the rice and I'll bring the soup.
example.zh: 你盛饭，我端汤。

entries.l1_note: dish out 也指“（随口）给予批评”，看宾语。

example.en: Put the food on plates and bring them out.
example.zh: 把菜盛到盘子里端出去。

entries.head: stuff down

senses.en: to eat something quickly, often without enjoying it

example.en: I stuffed down a sandwich between meetings.
example.zh: 我在两个会之间硬塞了个三明治。

entries.l1_note: 硬塞是 stuff down，带“没好好吃”的意味。

entries.head: wolf down

senses.en: to eat very quickly

example.en: He wolfed down two bowls of rice.
example.zh: 他狼吞虎咽吃了两碗饭。

entries.l1_note: 狼吞虎咽是 wolf down，不是 eat like a wolf（也有，但口语用前者）。

entries.head: gulp down

senses.en: to drink something quickly

example.en: He gulped down the coffee and ran out.
example.zh: 他一口灌下咖啡就跑了。

entries.l1_note: gulp down 是喝；吞食物用 swallow。

entries.head: sip on

senses.en: to drink something slowly over time

example.en: She sipped on herbal tea all afternoon.
example.zh: 她一下午都在慢慢喝茶。

entries.l1_note: 小口喝是 sip (on)，不是 drink slowly（也对但笨）。

entries.head: nibble on

senses.en: to eat small amounts slowly

example.en: She nibbled on a cookie while she studied.
example.zh: 她学习时一点点啃着饼干。

entries.l1_note: 小口咬是 nibble on；大口咬是 bite into。

entries.head: snack on

senses.en: to eat small amounts between meals

example.en: I've been snacking on nuts all day.
example.zh: 我一整天都在吃坚果当零食。

entries.l1_note: 零食是 snack on；不是 eat snacks（也对但少）。

entries.head: live on

senses.zh: 主要靠某样食物或钱生活
senses.en: to eat or survive mainly on one thing

example.en: Until payday I'm living on instant noodles.
example.zh: 发工资前我就靠泡面过。

entries.l1_note: 靠某样东西生活是 live on；live 单独是住。

entries.head: go off
entries.zh: 过期或坏了；爆炸/响起；离开

senses.en: when food becomes bad

example.en: Don't drink that — the milk has gone off.
example.zh: 别喝，牛奶坏了。

senses.en: to explode or make a sudden noise

example.en: My alarm went off at five, but I ignored it.
example.zh: 闹钟五点响了，我没理。

senses.en: to leave a place, often to do something

example.en: She went off to the pharmacy for cold medicine.
example.zh: 她去药店买感冒药了。

entries.l1_note: 食物坏是 go off（英式更常用）/ go bad；不是 become bad smell。

entries.head: finish off

senses.en: to eat or drink the last part

example.en: Who's going to finish off the cake?
example.zh: 谁来把蛋糕收尾？

entries.l1_note: 吃完剩下的是 finish off；finish 单独是完成。

entries.head: polish off

senses.en: to eat all of something quickly

example.en: He polished off a whole pizza by himself.
example.zh: 他一个人干掉了一整张披萨。

entries.l1_note: polish off 有“轻松干掉”的语气，比 eat up 生动。

entries.head: wash down

senses.en: to drink something while eating food

example.en: We washed down the hot pot with cold beer.
example.zh: 我们吃火锅配冰啤酒。

entries.l1_note: 就着吃是 wash down with；不是 drink together（中式）。
collocations: wash down a meal with tea

entries.head: sit down

senses.en: to lower your body into a sitting position

example.en: Sit down and I'll bring the menu.
example.zh: 您坐，我拿菜单来。

entries.l1_note: sit down 是不及物；seat 是及物，别写 seat down。

entries.head: take away

senses.en: to remove something from a place

example.en: The waiter took away our empty plates.
example.zh: 服务员把空盘子收走了。

entries.l1_note: take away 是“拿走/收走”；美式外卖更常说 takeout 或 to go。

entries.head: dig in

senses.en: 开吃

example.en: The noodles are here — dig in!
example.zh: 面来了，开吃！

entries.l1_note: dig in 是口语“开吃”；也可指“开始干”。

entries.head: drink up

senses.en: 喝完

example.en: Drink up — we need to catch the train.
example.zh: 喝完，我们得赶火车。

entries.l1_note: drink up 是喝完；drink 是喝。

example.en: I have breakfast at my desk while reading emails.
example.zh: 我在工位上一边看邮件一边吃早饭。

example.en: I make toast and eat it on the way to the subway.
example.zh: 我烤两片吐司，路上吃。

example.en: It takes seven minutes to boil an egg for breakfast.
example.zh: 早饭煮个鸡蛋要七分钟。

example.en: Pour some milk into the cereal and add a banana.
example.zh: 往麦片里倒点牛奶，再加根香蕉。

example.en: I ate in a hurry and left my phone on the table.
example.zh: 我匆匆吃完，把手机落在桌上了。

example.en: He fried some bacon and the whole apartment smelled of it.
example.zh: 他煎了培根，整个屋子都是味儿。

example.en: Clear the table and put the dishes in the sink.
example.zh: 收拾桌子，把碗放进水槽。

example.en: My dad fixes breakfast for us on Sundays.
example.zh: 周日我爸给我们做早饭。

example.en: I went without breakfast and was starving by ten.
example.zh: 我没吃早饭，十点就饿得不行。

example.en: Drink a glass of milk before bed if you're hungry.
example.zh: 睡前饿了就喝杯牛奶。

example.en: She makes a cup of tea and sits by the window.
example.zh: 她泡杯茶，坐在窗边。

example.en: He poured a cup of coffee for the client.
example.zh: 他给客户倒了杯咖啡。

example.en: Don't add sugar; the milk tea is already sweet.
example.zh: 别加糖了，奶茶已经够甜。

example.en: She stirred her coffee and checked the time.
example.zh: 她搅了搅咖啡，看了看时间。

example.en: I drink my coffee black, no milk and no sugar.
example.zh: 我喝黑咖啡，不加奶不加糖。

example.en: Boil water first, then add the tea leaves.
example.zh: 先烧水，再放茶叶。

example.en: Fill the kettle and switch it on.
example.zh: 把水壶灌满，按下开关。

example.en: I burned my tongue on the first sip of soup.
example.zh: 我喝第一口汤就烫到了舌头。

example.en: The meeting ran long, so I had a second cup.
example.zh: 会开得久，我又喝了一杯。

example.en: She blew on her coffee before taking a sip.
example.zh: 她吹了吹咖啡才喝。

example.en: I take my lunch break at twelve and walk for ten minutes.
example.zh: 我十二点午休，出去走十分钟。

example.en: We go out for lunch on Fridays if the weather is nice.
example.zh: 周五天气好我们就出去吃午饭。

example.en: I pack a lunch on Mondays to save money.
example.zh: 我周一自带午饭，省点钱。

example.en: It's hard to find a seat at noon in this building.
example.zh: 这栋楼中午很难找座位。

example.en: Let's grab lunch near the office.
example.zh: 我们在公司附近随便吃点午饭吧。

example.en: The whole team has lunch together on payday.
example.zh: 发工资那天全组一起吃午饭。

example.en: We usually go to the cafeteria on the second floor.
example.zh: 我们一般去二楼食堂。

example.en: Let's try a new place for lunch today.
example.zh: 今天午饭我们去试家新店。

example.en: My manager treated us to lunch after the launch.
example.zh: 上线后经理请我们吃了午饭。

example.en: I heat up my lunch in the office microwave at noon.
example.zh: 中午我用办公室微波炉热午饭。

example.en: We ordered a pizza because nobody wanted to cook.
example.zh: 没人想做饭，我们点了份比萨。

example.en: It's raining, so let's get delivery.
example.zh: 下雨了，点外卖吧。

example.en: You can order on the app and pick it up at the door.
example.zh: 你可以在 App 上下单，到门口取。

example.en: Type in your address and check the building number.
example.zh: 输入地址，核对一下楼号。

example.en: I picked a dish with less oil and more vegetables.
example.zh: 我挑了个少油多菜的。

example.en: I paid with my phone and the receipt went to my email.
example.zh: 我用手机付的款，收据发到邮箱了。

example.en: In the US, you usually leave a tip at a restaurant.
example.zh: 在美国，餐厅一般要给小费。

example.en: I kept tracking the order because I was starving.
example.zh: 我饿得不行，一直看订单到哪了。

example.en: We waited for the delivery for forty minutes.
example.zh: 我们等外卖等了四十分钟。

example.en: Check the order before the driver leaves.
example.zh: 骑手走之前核对一下订单。

example.en: I booked a table for six at seven thirty.
example.zh: 我订了七点半六个人的位子。

example.en: Read the menu first; the lunch special is cheaper.
example.zh: 先看菜单，午市套餐更便宜。

example.en: She ordered a salad and a glass of water.
example.zh: 她点了份沙拉和一杯水。

example.en: Ask the waiter about the specials before you order.
example.zh: 点之前问问服务员今天有什么特色菜。

entries.head: try the soup of the day

example.en: Let's try the soup of the day; it's tomato.
example.zh: 尝尝今天的例汤吧，是番茄的。

example.en: I'd like the sauce on the side, please.
example.zh: 酱汁请单放。

example.en: The steak is cold; can you take it back?
example.zh: 牛排是凉的，能退回去吗？

example.en: Call the waiter over and ask for the check.
example.zh: 把服务员叫过来结账。

example.en: We took the rest home and ate it for lunch.
example.zh: 剩下的打包带回家，第二天当午饭。

example.en: We paid our share and left separately.
example.zh: 我们各付各的，然后各自走了。

example.en: I'm meeting a friend for coffee at three.
example.zh: 我三点约了朋友喝咖啡。

example.en: He ordered his usual: an iced americano.
example.zh: 他点了老样子：冰美式。

example.en: I'll take my coffee to go.
example.zh: 我的咖啡打包带走。

example.en: Let's sit by the window if it's free.
example.zh: 窗边空着的话我们坐那儿。

example.en: We had a long chat over coffee.
example.zh: 我们边喝咖啡边聊了很久。

example.en: She works on her computer in the cafe every afternoon.
example.zh: 她每天下午在咖啡馆用电脑办公。

example.en: The kids had a cookie and a hot chocolate.
example.zh: 孩子们吃了块曲奇，喝了热巧克力。

example.en: You can ask for a refill at this cafe.
example.zh: 这家咖啡馆可以续杯。

example.en: Let's grab a table outside before the sun goes.
example.zh: 趁太阳还没落，占个外面的座位。

example.en: We ordered a piece of cake to share.
example.zh: 我们点了块蛋糕分着吃。

example.en: Do you want to grab a drink after work?
example.zh: 下班后去喝一杯吗？

example.en: He ordered a round for the table.
example.zh: 他给全桌请了一轮。

example.en: Let me buy you a drink; you just got the job.
example.zh: 我请你喝一杯，你刚拿到 offer。

example.en: We sat at the bar and watched the game.
example.zh: 我们坐在吧台看比赛。

example.en: Let's have a beer and talk about it.
example.zh: 喝杯啤酒，边喝边说。

example.en: The team goes to happy hour on Fridays.
example.zh: 团队周五去欢乐时光。

example.en: He likes his whiskey on the rocks.
example.zh: 他喝威士忌要加冰。

example.en: Let's toast to the new project.
example.zh: 为新项目干一杯。

example.en: Everyone raised their glasses and cheered.
example.zh: 大家举杯欢呼。

example.en: Last call is at midnight, so order now.
example.zh: 最后一轮是午夜，现在点吧。

example.en: I'm hungry; let's order something.
example.zh: 我饿了，点些吃的吧。

variants.head: starving

example.en: I'm starving; let's eat now.
example.zh: 我饿死了，现在就吃吧。

variants.note_zh: 夸张说法，比 hungry 重；日常口语最常用。

variants.head: famished

example.en: By noon I was famished.
example.zh: 到中午我已经饿坏了。

variants.note_zh: 偏正式/文学，程度重；日常口语少用。

variants.head: could eat a horse

example.en: I could eat a horse after that hike.
example.zh: 徒步完我饿得能吃下一头马。

variants.note_zh: 夸张习语，强调非常饿；通常只说自己。

example.en: I'm thirsty; can I get some water?
example.zh: 我渴了，能给我点水吗？

variants.head: parched

example.en: I'm parched after the run.
example.zh: 跑完步我渴得不行。

variants.note_zh: 口语，口干舌燥；比 thirsty 重。

variants.head: dehydrated

example.en: I felt dehydrated after the flight.
example.zh: 下飞机后我觉得有点脱水。

variants.note_zh: 偏医学/身体状态，不只是想喝水。

example.en: I'm dying of thirst; is there water?
example.zh: 我渴死了，有水吗？

example.en: I'm full; everything was delicious.
example.zh: 我吃饱了，都很好吃。

variants.head: stuffed

example.en: I'm stuffed; I can't eat another bite.
example.zh: 我吃撑了，一口都吃不下了。

variants.note_zh: 比 full 更口语，强调吃撑；常和 can't eat another bite 连用。

variants.head: full up

example.en: I'm full up, thanks.
example.zh: 我吃饱了，谢谢。

variants.note_zh: 口语，常用在拒绝加菜时；比 full 随意。

variants.head: can't eat another bite

example.en: I can't eat another bite.
example.zh: 我一口都吃不下了。

variants.note_zh: 完整说法，强调实在吃不下；不是“再吃一口”。
